## About
Low Price Auto Glass is a glass shop on Market Ave in Richmond. We replace and repair windshields and side glass, fix power windows and power locks, track down water leaks, and install Hüper Optik nano-ceramic window films.
Our salespeople will walk you through new and used glass and tell you what will work best for your car. If your window isn't working or your windshield has started leaking, our technicians can figure out what's going on and get you back on the road.
One reviewer called the owner, Mr. Singh, super friendly, and said technician Frankie found his bad window motor in minutes. We're rated 4.3 from 229 Google reviews.

## Services
- Windshield Replacement & Repair: Whether the whole windshield needs replacing or it's a small chip, we'll fix it and do it right the first time.
- Side glass: Broken door or side window? We take care of replacing damaged side glass too.
- Power windows and power locks: Window stuck or lock not working? We handle power windows, power locks and manual door repairs.
- Water leaks: If water is getting in around your glass, we can find the leak and fix it.
- Window Tinting: We do window tint too. One reviewer said Mr. Singh showed him the options and recommended what to get for different types of driving.

## FAQ
Q: Will my insurance cover it?
A: If you have full auto glass coverage on your auto insurance policy, our services are free to you. We're approved by all major insurance companies and can bill them directly.

Q: Do you offer emergency service?
A: Yes. Emergency service is available. Give us a call and tell us what happened.

Q: Do you carry new and used glass?
A: We do. Our salespeople will go over new and used options with you and recommend what will work best for your vehicle.

Q: Can I get a quote first?
A: Sure. Call us or use the quote form and we'll give you a free quote.
